correctness.rationale: For all integers a,b>=1, induction on the first opposite-side arrival proves only one coalition becomes mixed, all later agents enter it under the earliest-created positive-gain tie rule, and the r-1 stranded early same-side vertices cause the precise W/(2ab) deficit. Without-replacement run probabilities exhaust permutations; a symmetry argument gives exact expected gap, strict convexity gives the fixed-N sharp extrema, uniform order statistics give the Beta(a,1) limit, and bounded convergence from the exact mean gives the two-growing-parts L1 result. CHECK.py uses distinct direct coalition simulation and exact rational expressions and has passed 7418 color words, 316646 labeled permutations, rational distributions through sizes 8 and star laws through size 24. Infinite claims are proved, not extrapolated from the finite checks.

value.rationale: Uniform complete-bipartite positive cooperation is a natural two-community benchmark for irrevocable online coalition formation. The exact entire success distribution and sharp welfare sensitivity to part imbalance reveal an operational risk absent from coarse generic competitive orders: fixed minority size has a nondegenerate Beta law, including uniformly distributed quality on stars, while both populations growing yields near-optimal quality. The complete parameter classification and structural initial-run mechanism are mathematically motivated rather than a tabular recomputation or arbitrary slice.
